title: Flexible seat SKU + metered-token churn: invoice shadowing, provisional credits, and automated reconciliation
creator: Ariana Malik
description:
Summary: Run a production experiment that supports a new Flexible Seat SKU where customer seat counts (seats/licenses) and per-seat token consumption are both metered. The primary goal is to handle mid-cycle seat churn (up/down) without manual invoice corrections by creating a shadow invoice pipeline combined with a provisional credit ledger and automated reconciliation logic. This ticket covers product acceptance criteria, rollout plan, stakeholder sign-offs, and known edge cases (seat snapshot timing, reserved capacity vs. metered usage, and mid-cycle commit adjustments).

Why: Customers with enterprise contracts asked for smaller seat increments and flexible onboarding/offboarding; current billing cannot reconcile per-seat metering with mid-billing-cycle churn without raising manual tickets. This leads to delayed refunds, poor CSAT, and Ops overhead.

Scope: MVP for the experiment includes: 1) Shadow invoice generation for affected accounts (no customer-facing charge change for 30 days while experiment runs), 2) Provisional credit ledger entries that represent predicted refunds/charges, 3) A reconciliation job that converts provisional credits into final invoice adjustments at month-end (or earlier if threshold met), 4) Customer-visible audit trail in the billing portal, 5) Alerts for >2% invoice variance in a billing group.

Out of scope: full refunds for legacy prepaid bundles, complex cross-org seat transfers, and contract amendment UI (handled in follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Shadow invoices generated for 100% of pilot orgs and stored for 30 days without altering customer charges
Provisional credit ledger correctly reflects mid-cycle seat decreases with timestamped rationales and links to seat-change events
Automated reconciler runs at EOD and finalizes adjustments so that final invoice deltas vs. shadow are <= 1% for the pilot cohort
Customer billing portal shows audit trail entries for each provisional credit and final adjustment with readable reason text
No increase in support SLAs: billing tickets for pilot cohort must remain <= baseline (rolling 30d)
Rollout checklist and runbook approved by Security, Finance, and Revenue Ops
approach: Phase 0: Design review with Finance & Legal; produce confluence spec and data model for provisional_credits table
Phase 1: Implement shadow invoice generator (read-only) -- run daily for pilot orgs; persist results in billing-archive namespace
Phase 2: Create provisional credit ledger entries tied to seat-change webhook events with TTL and disposition states (pending/approved/finalized/rejected)
Phase 3: Reconciler job that compares actual metered tokens and seat snapshots to shadow invoice and issues final adjustments into the invoicing pipeline
Phase 4: Expose audit trail in billing portal and surface key metrics in Grafana and an ops dashboard
Phase 5: Pilot (5 enterprise customers) and measure; iterate on edge-case handlers (seat re-add within grace window, simultaneous seat and reserved-capacity changes)
Fallback: If reconciler raises high variance or exceptions, pause auto-finalize and escalate to manual review queue (Revenue Ops)
Data retention & privacy: provisional credit entries will be encrypted at rest and respect org-level data retention settings
risks_mitigation: Risk: Incorrect seat snapshot timing leading to double credits. Mitigation: use canonical seat-change event with sequence numbers and conservative grace window (48h) for auto-finalize.
Risk: Large invoice delta causing customer dispute. Mitigation: shadow invoices visible to customer in billing portal; allow customers opt-out of auto-finalize for first billing cycle.
Risk: Fraud/abuse via rapid seat churn. Mitigation: rate-limit seat-change credits and surface anomaly detection on churn rate per org.
Risk: Accounting mismatch for reserved capacity commitments. Mitigation: reserved capacity flags override auto-credit path and are reconciled in separate revenue adjustments (Finance-owned).
metrics: % pilot orgs with final invoice delta <= 1% (target 95%+)
Mean time to finalize provisional credit (target <72h after month end)
Number of manual billing tickets opened per 100 pilot invoices (target <= baseline)
Customer satisfaction (post-pilot CSAT on billing experience)
% of provisional credits auto-finalized vs. escalated
rollout_plan: Week 0: Internal sign-offs (Finance, Legal, Security, Revenue Ops) and data model approval -- link to confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/BILL/Flex-Seat-SKU-Experiment
Week 1: Engineering build for shadow invoices and provisional_credits schema (ENG-53421 dependent) -- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/3124
Week 2: Reconciler job and portal UI for audit trail; deploy to staging and run end-to-end smoke tests
Week 3: Small enterprise pilot (5 orgs); run shadow invoices in prod, no customer charges changed; gather telemetry
Week 4: Review pilot results; if metrics pass, enable auto-finalize for pilot orgs with opt-in; extend pilot to 25 orgs and begin billing adjustments in write-mode
Rollback: disable auto-finalize and revert to manual provisioning; purge no more than last 30 days of provisional ledger if required by Finance
